Witch Art Lab

Night in the forest: twilight everywhere, and the witch's glow shows the true colours near her. Pick the variant you like best and it becomes the new style; the next six grow from it. Drag knobs to steer by hand.

Pick one

Map

A whole run's forest: 20 × 20 areas cut by Boris the Brave's fractal jittered Voronoi. Each colour is an area type, never beside itself; white dots are area centres, where the clearings are; the ringed area in the middle holds the dancefloor. "New forest layout" draws a new map; "Border detail" sets how many fractal layers shape the borders.

Bestiary

Thirty forest animals, each as legend, young and baby, in the current style under even light, turned towards you (or away, for creatures walking up the screen). Legends grow the magical features listed.

Sigils

Each creature's sigil: its name written in the forest's magic. Left, flat, as it appears on its card and in the interface. Right, written on the ground at the game's angle, as the leashing rune when the witch leashes it: it draws on, then glows and pulses.

Sprite sheet

Soundsystems

What the party defends: a sound-system stack hewn from magic stone, with glowing crystal cones. Each of the three stacks is shown playing (three frames of the cones pumping), damaged (two frames of flicker) and destroyed, with the witch for scale.
